report_name: Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan 2020 – 2030
how_pct_was_used: The Propensity to Cycle Tool was used as part of the evidence base to help map and consider future cycling networks and identify proposed new routes.
other_tools_developed: Route Selection Tool, Walking Route Audit Tool, and a prioritisation matrix based on effectiveness, policy fit, deliverability, and affordability.
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP process and evidence base have directly informed the identification of cycling and walking infrastructure improvements for future investment, supported the development of the 'Walk. Ride. Thrive' initiative, and provided a strategic framework to make the case for future funding and investment in active travel.
pct_usage_quote: A range of online tools including a Propensity to Cycle Tool, a Route Selection Tool, and a Walking Route Audit Tool were also prepared by the Department for Transport (DfT) and made available to help develop local plans.
